name: bc-application-assistant
description: Windows development preview for factual BC university application drafts. Requires a PSR PDF. Shared evidence-backed profile, generic native-form plans, UC/MIT/Common App workflows and saved readback. Full live coverage remains unverified.

interface.longDescription: Windows desktop development preview for BC students applying for Fall 2027. Edge first. Requires a PSR PDF and one canonical JSON. Source-backed drafts, saved readback and recovery support observed UC, MIT and Common App pages. Common App school dates and student-provided transfer/early-graduation explanations passed actual changed-value save/readback/restoration. First-use school and course creation passed fictional Edge tests; actual new-record rollback and the complete fresh-student workflow remain unverified. General essays, subjective answers, submissions, invitations, declarations and payments stay manual. No College Planner connection exists.
defaultPrompt: Check whether I have the PSR and permissions needed to prepare my BC university application.
